text:
Hi there, and thank you for contacting Leafy! I'm sorry your fiddle leaf fig is struggling. That's stressful, especially with a new plant.

Unfortunately, this isn't covered by our Plant Care Guarantee. Repotting into non-Leafy soil within the first 14 days after delivery is one of the situations the guarantee doesn't cover, so I can't offer a free replacement for it.

There are still a few things that can help:

- **Free care advice:** A Plant Care Specialist can help you try to save your plant, by chat or email, at no cost. Fiddle leaf figs can bounce back from a rough start, especially if the issue is soil or watering.
- **Quick watering check:** Overwatering is the most common cause of early problems. Water only when the top inch of soil is dry.
- **Damaged on arrival:** If the plant arrived with snapped stems, exposed roots or a cracked pot, that's handled separately. It needs to be reported within 48 hours of delivery, with photos of the plant and the box.

If you think your situation deserves a second look, just let me know and I can pass it to a Support Lead to review.

Thanks for giving your plant a loving home. I hope it perks up soon, and please reach out any time!
